# Pic Gallery Brand Spec

## Visual Identity: Luminous Vault (User)
Targeting high-end, artistic, and immersive workspace for AI generation.

### Color Tokens (OKLch)
- `--bg`: `oklch(12% 0.015 260)` (#05070d) - Deep space background
- `--surface`: `oklch(16% 0.02 260)` (#090c14) - Elevated panel surface
- `--fg`: `oklch(95% 0.01 80)` (#f6efe4) - Warm parchment text
- `--muted`: `oklch(90% 0.01 80 / 0.68)` - De-emphasized text
- `--border`: `oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.08)` - Hairline dividers
- `--accent`: `oklch(70% 0.12 75)` (#d49d5e) - Golden highlights
- `--accent-coral`: `oklch(65% 0.14 45)` (#cb7c4d)
- `--accent-purple`: `oklch(60% 0.18 275)` (#8376ff)
- `--accent-emerald`: `oklch(75% 0.15 165)` (#41b995)

### Typography
- **Display**: `Cormorant Garamond`, serif - Used for headers and artistic emphasis.
- **Body**: `Manrope`, sans-serif - Used for controls, labels, and primary reading.
- **Mono**: `JetBrains Mono`, monospace - Used for API keys and technical data.

### Layout Posture
- **Sidebar**: Fixed left-side navigation (108px wide).
- **TopBar**: Fixed global header (76px high).
- **Radii**: Smooth curves (`--pg-radius-md: 18px`).
- **Material**: Glassmorphism, subtle glows, and metallic gradients.

---

## Visual Identity: Soft Grid Ops (Admin)
Targeting reliable, minimalist, and high-density operation dashboard.

### Color Tokens (OKLch)
- `--bg`: `oklch(96% 0.005 230)` (#eef2f4) - Soft blue-grey sky
- `--surface`: `oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.8)` (#ffffffcc) - Frosted white surface
- `--fg`: `oklch(25% 0.02 240)` (#1a2532) - Deep slate text
- `--muted`: `oklch(55% 0.02 240)` (#68788b) - Slate grey text
- `--border`: `oklch(25% 0.02 240 / 0.09)` - Soft grid lines
- `--accent`: `oklch(55% 0.12 250)` (#5775b9) - Professional blue

### Typography
- **Display**: `Fraunces`, serif - Subtle distinction for headers.
- **Body**: `Manrope`, sans-serif - Optimized for data scanning.

### Layout Posture
- **Sidebar**: Fixed left-side navigation (216px wide).
- **TopBar**: Fixed global header (76px high).
- **Radii**: Crisp curves (`--pg-radius-sm: 12px`).
- **Material**: Clean grids, subtle shadows, flat surfaces.
